supplements.title: Optimization, characterization and biological activity of siderophore produced by marine Streptomyces coelicolor.
supplements.summary: Marine Streptomyces coelicolor-derived siderophore ferrioxamine effectively inhibited breast cancer cell (MCF-7) proliferation by disrupting iron homeostasis.

supplements.title: Multi-omics unravels multiple pharmacological actions in a murine model of infantile hemangioma receiving oxymatrine therapy.
supplements.summary: Oxymatrine effectively inhibits infantile hemangioma growth by targeting multiple molecular pathways in a mouse model, offering a potential alternative treatment for drug-resistant cases.

supplements.title: Sodium butyrate induces apoptosis enhanced by JAK2 inhibitor Fedratinib in NK/T-cell lymphoma cell.
supplements.summary: Combining sodium butyrate and the JAK2 inhibitor Fedratinib effectively triggered cell death in NK/T-cell lymphoma cells.

supplements.title: Biosynthesis of Silver Nanoparticles Using Black Pepper (Piper nigrum) Seed Extract and Evaluation of Their Cytotoxicity.
supplements.summary: Black pepper seed extract-derived silver nanoparticles showed enhanced cytotoxicity against gastric cancer cells, offering a promising green synthesis approach for targeted cancer treatment.

supplements.title: Metabolite Profiling and Anticancer Evaluation of Iraqi Haloxylon articulatum Halophyte via LC-HRMS/MS, Molecular Docking, and ADMET Analysis.
supplements.summary: Hydroalcoholic extract of Haloxylon articulatum showed promising anticancer effects against gastric cancer cells by inhibiting tumor cell proliferation through specific phytochemical compounds.

supplements.title: Diverse Meroterpenoids from the Endophytic Fungus Penicillium oxalicum and Their Cytotoxic Activities.
supplements.summary: Researchers discovered new meroterpenoid compounds from a fungus that showed weak to moderate cytotoxic potential against certain tumor cell lines.

supplements.title: Stigmasterol Inhibits Glioma Metastasis and Angiogenesis by Regulating Macrophage Polarization.
supplements.summary: Stigmasterol inhibits glioma growth and spread by blocking the transformation of macrophages into tumor-promoting forms, reducing cancer progression.

supplements.title: 50k4Life: A SMART study protocol to improve walking engagement in public school employees on the US-Mexico border.
supplements.summary: A workplace physical activity intervention aims to increase walking among public school employees near the US-Mexico border to reduce cardiometabolic and cancer risks.

supplements.title: A Randomized, Open-Label Trial to Assess Feasibility and Tolerability of Topical Cannabis Balms for the Treatment of Aromatase Inhibitor-Associated Musculoskeletal Syndrome (AIMSS).
supplements.summary: Cannabis-based topical balms may help reduce musculoskeletal pain and inflammation for breast cancer patients experiencing side effects from aromatase inhibitor treatments.

supplements.title: Bioactivity-Guided Isolation of Cytotoxic Compounds From Curcuma caesia: In Vitro and In Silico Investigation for Oral Cancer.
supplements.summary: Furanodienone, a sesquiterpenoid from Curcuma caesia, shows promising potential for oral cancer treatment by inhibiting cell growth and targeting key cancer-related proteins.

supplements.title: Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry-Based Phytochemical Composition and Bioactivities of Lilium polyphyllum Bulb Extracts: Insights Into Anticancer and Antidiabetic Potential.
supplements.summary: Lilium polyphyllum bulb extracts demonstrated potent anticancer activity against leukemia cells and potential antidiabetic properties through unique phytochemical compounds.

supplements.title: Antidepressant-Like Mechanisms of Gekko gecko Active Compounds: Multi-Omics Elucidation of the cAMP-PRKACA-BDNF Signaling Axis.
supplements.summary: Gekko gecko compounds showed antidepressant effects in mice by activating key brain signaling pathways and reducing neuroinflammation.

supplements.title: [A network pharmacology-based study to explore the mechanism of a novel sleep-aiding soup for the treatment of insomnia by modulating microglia activation].
supplements.summary: A novel sleep-aid herbal decoction suppresses microglial inflammation through multiple signaling pathways, potentially alleviating insomnia by reducing neuroinflammatory responses.

supplements.title: Four New Triterpenoids From Rubus pirifolius Smith.
supplements.summary: Two triterpenoid compounds from Rubus pirifolius showed promising cytotoxic activity against five different cancer cell lines, including leukemia and breast cancer.

supplements.title: Four New Polyhydroxylated Secondary Metabolites From Sinularia sp. and Their Biological Activities.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified new chemical compounds from soft coral that showed potential cytotoxic effects against multiple cancer cell lines, including leukemia and breast cancer cells.

off_label.title: Kisspeptin improves local ovarian insulin resistance in PCOS by modulating the PI3K/AKT/GLUT4 signaling pathway.
off_label.summary: Kisspeptin treatment helped reduce insulin resistance in women with polycystic ovary syndrome by improving insulin signaling in ovarian cells.

off_label.title: Multi-omics unravels multiple pharmacological actions in a murine model of infantile hemangioma receiving oxymatrine therapy.
off_label.summary: Oxymatrine effectively inhibits infantile hemangioma growth by targeting multiple molecular pathways in a mouse model, offering a potential alternative treatment for drug-resistant cases.

off_label.title: Drug Repurposing Screen Identifies Pimozide as a ROS-Inducing Therapy With Anti-Tumor Efficacy in HNSCC PDX Models.
off_label.summary: Pimozide, an existing drug, effectively induces reactive oxygen species and suppresses head and neck cancer cell growth, showing potential as a new targeted cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Hypoxia Alleviation-Potentiated Chemotherapy Enhances Anti-PD-L1 Treatment for Triple-Negative Breast Cancer via Improving Tumor Immunogenicity and Inhibiting STAT3 Activation.
off_label.summary: A new nanomedicine combining paclitaxel and atovaquone improves triple-negative breast cancer treatment by making tumors more responsive to immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Metformin-Mediated Glycaemic Regulation as a Potential Strategy for Breast Cancer Prevention.
off_label.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

Metformin, a diabetes drug, shows potential to prevent breast cancer by disrupting cancer cell growth mechanisms.

off_label.title: Efficacy of Topical Beta-Blockers in Managing Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor Inhibitor-Related Paronychia and Pyogenic Granuloma-Like Lesion: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
off_label.summary: Topical beta-blockers effectively manage skin lesions caused by cancer drugs targeting epidermal growth factor receptors, improving patient comfort.

off_label.title: Remimazolam Inhibits Neuronal Apoptosis, Inflammation, and Ferroptosis in Cerebral Infarction via Promoting TRIM67-Mediated Degradation of ACSL4.
off_label.summary: Remimazolam protects against neuronal damage in cerebral infarction by reducing inflammation and cell death through targeting specific protein interactions.

off_label.title: Long lasting response to the combination of Avutometinib and Defactinib after progression on Binimetinib in a patient with recurrent low grade serous ovarian carcinoma - A case report.
off_label.summary:
Here's a clear summary sentence focusing on the key finding:

A patient with treatment-resistant low-grade serous ovarian cancer showed a long-lasting response to a new combination of targeted drugs after previous treatments failed.

off_label.title: Metformin glycyrrhetinic acid binary injectable hydrogel for synergistic tumor immunotherapy via spatiotemporal microenvironment remodeling.
off_label.summary: An injectable hydrogel combining metformin and glycyrrhetinic acid with magnetic nanoparticles successfully reprograms the tumor immune environment, enhancing cancer immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Biomimetic hybrid membrane-coated nanoparticles loaded with rhein-iron complex enhance ferroptosis and immunotherapy for triple-negative breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Nanoparticles loaded with rhein-iron complex effectively induce cancer cell death and boost immune response in aggressive triple-negative breast cancer.

off_label.title: Sevoflurane's inhibitory effect on postoperative colorectal cancer cell proliferation.
off_label.summary: Sevoflurane, a surgical anesthetic, showed potential in reducing the growth of colorectal cancer cells after surgery.

off_label.title: Lack of Cancer Specificity of Methionine Adenosyltransferase 2A (MAT2A) Inhibitor AG-270 in Combination With Recombinant Methioninase In Vitro.
off_label.summary: The study found that the MAT2A inhibitor AG-270 was not cancer-specific when combined with methioninase, challenging its potential as a targeted anti-cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Targeted Sensitization of Leukemic T-cells to Anticancer Drugs by SIRT1 Agonist SRT-1720.
off_label.summary: SRT-1720, a SIRT1 agonist, enhances leukemia treatment by increasing cancer cell sensitivity to anticancer drugs while sparing normal lymphocytes.

off_label.title: Synergistic Effects of Honokiol on Camptothecin-triggered Apoptosis of Drug-resistant Glioblastoma Cells via CDK1-mediated G2/M Arrest and Intrinsic ROS-Mitochondrion-dependent Pathway.
off_label.summary: Honokiol combined with camptothecin effectively kills drug-resistant glioblastoma cells by enhancing cell death mechanisms at low, safe concentrations.

off_label.title: Understanding obesity-cancer crosstalk to inform the immunomodulatory roles of anti-obesity nanotherapeutics.
off_label.summary: Nanomedicine targeting adipose inflammation shows promise in potentially reducing obesity-related cancer progression by modulating immune responses and metabolic dysfunction.

biomarkers.title: DNA methylation triage of human papillomavirus-positive atypical squamous cells of undetermined significance in cervical cancer screening.
biomarkers.summary: A DNA methylation test could help reduce unnecessary colposcopy referrals for women with HPV and uncertain cervical cell changes.

biomarkers.title: Malassezia globosa lipidome: The dynamics of uptake and secreted lipids.
biomarkers.summary: A detailed analysis of Malassezia globosa lipid dynamics reveals complex consumption and secretion patterns of 87 lipids across different metabolic phases.

biomarkers.title: Adding anti-PD-1 antibody to definitive chemoradiotherapy in elderly patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: higher intensity does not equate to better outcomes.
biomarkers.summary: For elderly esophageal cancer patients, adding an anti-PD-1 antibody to standard chemoradiation did not improve treatment outcomes or survival.

biomarkers.title: GNE-related thrombocytopenia (Thrombocytopenia-12) in a 3-month-old from a Middle Eastern background infant: a case report.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a rare genetic mutation causing low platelet count in a young infant from a Middle Eastern family, expanding understanding of congenital thrombocytopenia.

biomarkers.title: Non-coding small RNAs buffer protein interactions to prevent oncogenic aggregation: structural dampening of aberrant PPIs by RNA.
biomarkers.summary: Non-coding RNAs can prevent cancer-causing protein aggregation by buffering protein interactions and maintaining structural stability in molecular complexes.

biomarkers.title: PTP1B inhibition promotes microglial phagocytosis in Alzheimer's disease models by enhancing SYK signaling.
biomarkers.summary: PTP1B inhibition enhances microglia's ability to clear amyloid plaques in Alzheimer's disease by boosting immune cell function and metabolism.

biomarkers.title: Childhood thiamine-responsive megaloblastic anemia and diabetes: a case series highlighting early diagnosis and management.
biomarkers.summary: Targeted high-dose thiamine therapy can quickly improve symptoms and prevent long-term complications in children with a rare genetic disorder causing anemia and early-onset diabetes.

biomarkers.title: Theranostic Folate-Targeted Doxorubicin-Loaded MIL-88A@CuFe2O4 Nanohybrids, a pH-Sensitive, Core-Shell, Mesoporous Drug Delivery Platform with Dual-Modal T1-T2MRI and Optical Imaging Contrast Properties: An In Vitro and In Vivo Cancer Study.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a novel nanoplatform that combines targeted drug delivery, dual-mode imaging, and effective therapy for triple-negative breast cancer.

biomarkers.title: Pediatric craniopharyngioma: when hypoglycemia reveals a brain tumor. Illustrative case.
biomarkers.summary: A pediatric brain tumor (craniopharyngioma) was uniquely first detected through severe low blood sugar, highlighting an uncommon initial symptom of this rare condition.

biomarkers.title: Primary subdural tumor mimicking subdural hematoma: illustrative case.
biomarkers.summary: A rare pediatric case highlights how some subdural tumors can look like blood clots on initial medical imaging.

biomarkers.title: Challenges in diagnosing and treating lumbosacral dermoid cyst in an older patient: illustrative case.
biomarkers.summary:
Here's a concise summary sentence:

A rare lumbosacral dermoid cyst in an older patient underscores the importance of considering this diagnosis despite nonspecific symptoms.

biomarkers.title: Molecular classification of radiation-induced meningiomas.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers classified radiation-induced meningiomas using molecular techniques to better understand their unique genetic characteristics and potential clinical implications.

biomarkers.title: The role of HLA transcription in unrelated hematopoietic cell transplantation.
biomarkers.summary: In unrelated hematopoietic cell transplantation, higher HLA gene expression levels are linked to increased graft-versus-host disease risk and potentially lower relapse rates.

biomarkers.title: CPX-351 Selectively Benefits Patients with AML and Myelodysplasia-Related Mutations in the Pivotal Randomized Trial.
biomarkers.summary: In AML patients with myelodysplasia-related mutations, CPX-351 significantly improved overall survival compared to standard therapy, particularly for those undergoing transplantation.

biomarkers.title: Allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation in ERCC6L2 Disease.
biomarkers.summary: Allogeneic stem cell transplantation offers a potential cure for ERCC6L2 disease, with 79% one-year survival but significant risks of endothelial complications.
